# Iron Never Changes

> Iron Never Changes is a heavyweight gym wear brand for men with jobs, kids and a bar in their week. Garment-dyed cotton tees, screen printed in one color of ink. The name finishes as "Iron never changes. You do." House slogan: "Where limits meet defeat."

Status: the shop is open and stays open. There are no drops and no preorders: every shirt, wash and size is on sale at the price shown, shipped anywhere in the US at one flat rate.

## The line

- 28 shirts, each in all four washes (washed black, blue, grey and brown), sizes S to 3XL, $34 to $42.
- Heavyweight, garment-dyed, screen printed, so the print cracks and fades with wear. No tech fabric, no neon.
- Designs come from the brand's slogan bank and from real hard stretches: "I didn't feel like it either", "Proud of you. Somebody should say it.", "Say it out loud. It weighs less.", "The bar doesn't know you're tired", "Lost, not gone." and more.
- [The Shop](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#shop): every shirt, front and back, with its print spec and price.

## Coaching

- [The Corner](https://www.ironneverchanges.com/#corner): coaching with Zac, $100 a month, month to month. Meal plans from real groceries, lifting programs built around your schedule, unlimited talk and text, video form checks, monthly progress tracking. Coaching sign-up is not on the site yet.
